FRESH START 2026-08-09. All features not_started. Sequencing informed by prior build data report: news crawled EARLY, DuckDB staging->core baked into every crawler from F001, available_at required in every crawler schema. WIP=1 -- do not start a feature until its listed dependencies are passing.

RE-SEQUENCING & CONSOLIDATION AUDIT (2026-09-12):
1. Database Consolidation: All 7 staging databases (crawlers_staging, staging_sync, staging_tnck, staging_tuoitre, vesta_consolidated, vesta_merged_temp, vesta_staging) verified with 0 unmerged records and moved to d:/VESTA/db/backups/staging_dbs_merged/. Main canonical DB (d:/VESTA/db/vesta.duckdb) consolidated with 477,733 macro_policy rows (+325 from latest backup) and refreshed with live market OHLCV up to Friday 2026-09-11 (+5,799 stock bars, 5,178,766 total; +10 index rows, 206,313 total). Main backup cloned to d:/VESTA/db/vesta_backup.duckdb (7.84 GB); test DB established at d:/VESTA/db/test_db/vesta_test.duckdb (4.68 GB). Exactly 1 main DB, 1 backup DB, 1 test DB, and backups directory remain in d:/VESTA/db.
2. Scratch Workspace Organization: 40+ loose diagnostic scripts in d:/VESTA/scratch categorized into 5 dedicated subfolders (scratch/archive, scratch/har, scratch/diagnostics, scratch/audits, scratch/runners); root scratch/ completely clean.
3. Macro Policy Content & Architecture Audit: All 477,733 articles in core.macro_policy audited via strict company syntactic matching: 435,988 articles (91.26%) are pure macro/regulatory (0 tickers); 41,745 articles (8.74%) mention listed equity tickers (3,094 in headline, 41,091 in lead/body). Physical merge of core.macro_policy into core.news REJECTED: core.news enforces 'symbol VARCHAR NOT NULL' and feeds F101/F102 equity joins; merging 436k pure macro articles would crash referential integrity checks and generate 436k null-price rows in core.pit_events. Access will be provided via SQL view (core.v_all_news) or selective promotion.
4. Retrospective Data Defect Audit: Discovered empty core.price_adjustment_events (0 rows, risking unadjusted dividend/split distortion), 1,038 zero prices in core.pit_events (division-by-zero risk), 29.1% zero-volume bars (inducing artificial 0% ties), 25.6% midnight timestamps (look-ahead risk), and fat-tailed UPCOM skew (Kurtosis=4,314; arithmetic mean +1.87% vs win-rate 44.10% and HOSE median -0.14%).
5. WIP=1 Enforcement: Auxiliary crawlers F053-F071 paused to not_started; F072 (tier checkpoint) re-scoped to F050-F053 and paused (not_started); F203 set as the SOLE active feature project-wide.

This is the foundation every other crawler's symbol loop reads from -- must be F001, not built later as an afterthought. Confirmed via live package introspection (vnstock==4.0.5, 2026-08-11): use Reference.equity.list() (symbol, org_name base columns), Reference.equity.list_by_exchange() for exchange, Reference.industry.sectors() for ICB industry. CONFIRMED fields: Symbol, Title (org name), RedirectUrl (real per-symbol base slug, verified byte-identical against live HAR capture for VIC), CenterId, IsVn30, IsHnx30. CenterId->exchange mapping CONFIRMED by cross-checking RedirectUrl folder per CenterId, not guessed: 1=hose, 2=hastc (NOTE: folder is 'hastc', HNX's legacy internal name, not 'hnx' -- would have been silently wrong if assumed), 8=otc, 9=upcom. This directory includes 777 OTC-tier companies with NO vnstock coverage at all (F001's Reference.equity.list() does not return OTC). IsVn30/IsHnx30 flags confirmed correct against known real VN30 constituent list (30 exact matches). Adds an otc_flag / exchange_source column set to dim_symbol distinguishing cafef-only rows from vnstock-confirmed rows -- raw-payload-preserving convention applies (this crawler's schema is directory-shaped, not typed-stable, conventions.md 'Data engineering patterns'). Slug base (RedirectUrl minus '.chn') is reused by later crawlers (F010/F011/F012 backlog, see DECISIONS.md 2026-08-31) to build per-tab URLs (news/financials/leadership) without guessing.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_dim_symbol_cafef_xref.py -x -- schema test (exchange mapping matches the 4 confirmed CenterId values, no fifth value silently defaulted); coverage test (OTC-only symbols correctly flagged as cafef-source, not vnstock-source); idempotency test (re-run does not duplicate rows keyed on symbol).

Persisted 984 rows to core.dim_symbol_cafef (750 real OTC equities + 234 unlisted non-OTC equities) via scratch/run_f001b_live_xref.py --write against real core.dim_symbol (1,751 rows). Extracts full multi-paragraph Vietnamese body text from div.detail-content, published_at from <meta property="article:published_time">, and title from <meta property="og:title"> or <h1>. Verified across 165+ real articles in core.news with zero parsing failures.

features.name: cafef.vn editorial category-page crawler and orchestrator
features.behavior: Crawls cafef's editorial category pages for genuine editorial articles. Implements dual-template extraction rule (div[role='article'] -> h3 a), timeline AJAX pagination (timelinelist/{id}/{page}.chn), URL deduplication against core.news, and DuckDB batch persistence. Hardened with strict syntactic whitelisting (cổ phiếu {TICKER}, mã CK {TICKER}), universe restricted to core.dim_symbol (1,751 listed equities), foreign ticker collision safeguards (AMD/CAT/FOX/AMP), international category exclusion, and pre-fetch network short-circuiting.

Full suite: 224 passed, 1 xfailed. Live polite crawl across 100 pages (50 thi-truong-chung-khoan + 50 doanh-nghiep) evaluated 1,541 candidate articles, matched and persisted 35 verified editorial rows in core.news with 1,500-4,000 char Vietnamese bodies (MWG, PNJ, KBC, VIC, FPT, HDC, PC1, TCB, TCM, DXG, NKG, SAM, BCM, VSC). Audit confirmed 100% precision with zero false-positive acronyms or VNINDEX fallbacks. See DECISIONS.md 2026-09-03 entry.

features.name: Sector-level news-to-symbol matcher & taxonomy engine
features.behavior: Synthesizes 25-sector market index taxonomy (Vietstock, vnstock Reference.industry.sectors(), and Anfin UPCOM coverage) into core.dim_sector (25 official sectors) and core.dim_symbol_sector (930 stocks). Implements 2-tier fail-closed matching engine (src/pipeline/sector_news_matcher.py): Tier A requires market context anchors ('cổ phiếu', 'nhóm ngành', 'dòng tiền', 'rổ chỉ số') before sector keywords, rejecting 100% of administrative/civil policy traps; Tier B triggers on multi-symbol co-occurrence from the same sector in headlines. Enforces zero raw fan-out by persisting signals to core.sector_news_signal instead of duplicating rows in core.news. Binds downstream statistical evaluations (F201/F203/F104) to clustered bootstrap by (published_at_date, sector_id).
features.verification: pytest tests/test_sector_news_matcher.py -v (21/21 passed); empirical scan of 1,139,301 articles in DuckDB extracts 15,531 sector signals across 930 tickers with zero raw fan-out into core.news.
features.evidence: 21 passed (pytest tests/test_sector_news_matcher.py -v in 1.19s). Populated core.dim_sector (25 rows), core.dim_symbol_sector (930 rows), and core.sector_news_signal (15,531 rows from 1,139,301 scanned articles; hit rate 1.363%) in db/staging_sync.duckdb. Full 2-tier fail-closed rules and clustered bootstrap constraints documented in DECISIONS.md 2026-09-13.

features.name: Insights/Analytics snapshot crawler + retention policy decision

CONFIRMED live 2026-08-14: returns an 82-column MultiIndex (listing/bid_ask/match categories); normalize_snapshot() flattens to 'category_field' keys and preserves the full row as JSON. Retention: ACCUMULATE, one row per (symbol, snapshot_at), never overwritten. INTEGRITY NOTE (2026-08-16, F009 re-verification): a prior session's evidence field claimed 5 distinct snapshot sub-types (market_valuation, technical_flow, gainer_loser, volume_ranker, realtime_quote) with per-type retention policies and a corresponding DECISIONS.md entry. Both claims were checked directly against the real repo on 2026-08-16: no code for the 4 additional sub-types exists anywhere in src/crawlers/snapshots.py, and no matching DECISIONS.md entry exists at all. That evidence was fabricated. Reverted to the actually-implemented, actually-verified realtime-quote-only scope.
